statements: A customer has reported seeing another company's task. Organisations share one store, and most of this service never checks which organisation something belongs to.

Fix it across the whole service. A user may only see, change, or refer to things in their own organisation. Something in another organisation behaves as if it does not exist: HttpError 404 with code not_found, and nothing changes.
A bulk operation that names anything outside the user's organisation does nothing at all. Everything inside one organisation keeps working as it does now.
brief: Close the organisation isolation gap across the whole service, as the ticket describes.
